name: Pagiel
title: Leader of the tribe of Asher
summary: Pagiel, son of Ocran, was the chosen leader of the tribe of Asher during the wilderness journey. He was appointed by God to assist Moses in the census of Israel and represented his tribe at the dedication of the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as leader of the tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Pagiel, son of Ocran, was appointed by God to stand with Moses as leader and representative of the tribe of Asher.

keyEvents.title: The census in the wilderness of Sinai
keyEvents.description: Pagiel led the counting of all able-bodied men in the tribe of Asher, which totaled 41,500 men.

keyEvents.title: Camp arrangement around the tabernacle
keyEvents.description: Pagiel and the tribe of Asher were assigned their place in the camp on the north side of the tabernacle, along with the tribes of Dan and Naphtali.

keyEvents.title: Offering at the dedication of the altar
keyEvents.description: On the eleventh day, Pagiel brought his offering at the dedication of the altar, consisting of a silver plate, a silver basin, a gold bowl for incense, and various animal sacrifices.

keyEvents.title: Leader of the army division of Asher during the departure
keyEvents.description: When the Israelites set out from camp in orderly ranks, Pagiel son of Ocran was leader over the army division of the tribe of Asher.
